text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Pager: gpu-capacity-exhaustion-prod-1 triggered (queue growth + autoscaler failures). Alert: https://alerts.redwood.example/alerts/12345

sre-alex: seeing massive backlog on inference-queue, token processing time spiking. queue depth ~1.2k, backlog rate +180 req/min.

infra-maya: autoscaler logs show repeated failures creating nodes in nodegroup gpu-pool-prod-1. error snippets: 
`AttachRolePolicyNotFound: The instance profile role cannot be found` and occasionally `InvalidLaunchTemplateVersion`.

mlops-raj: pods pending due to `nodeSelector` + gpu taint. Many pods stuck `0/35 nodes are available: 35 node(s) had no available GPUs` even though ASG attempted scale.

support-sam: customers A & B report elevated 5xx and long tail latency, support queue getting noisy. I flagged a handful of VIP tenants.

oncall-nick: I'm on it, shifting from monitoring to mitigation. Handing off to day SRE in ~20m.

eng-runtime-joel: can we temporarily divert traffic to smaller models / CPU fallback? we have a fallback route for low-priority traffic.

product-lina: prioritize customer-facing inference requests (VIP) and degrade batch sizes for background jobs. communicate ETA to support.

infra-maya: investigating launch template drift. Looks like an automated change rolled out last night that updated instance profile name from `redwood-gpu-role-v1` to `redwood-gpu-role-v2` but ASG is still referencing the old profile.

sre-alex: confirmed. ASG describe shows `InstanceProfile: arn:aws:iam::123456789:instance-profile/redwood-gpu-role-v1` which no longer exists. This causes instance initialization to fail and nodes never become Ready.

mlops-raj: that explains the attach role errors. Pods keep pending; autoscaler keeps trying but nodes fail to register, queue keeps growing.

infra-maya: quick mitigation option: update ASG to point to the new launch template version with the correct instance profile. I can push a rollback to previous LT if needed.

sre-alex: before we change LT, we should open a maintenance window because changes to launch templates may trigger instance replacement. we need temporary steps to relieve pressure now.

eng-runtime-joel: we can also reduce max-concurrency and decrease batching window on the runtime pool to lower GPU pressure while we fix nodes. pushing config will reduce throughput but buys time.

oncall-nick: executing runtime throttle now. Patch request: `POST /admin/runtime/config` 
```
{"route":"/inference/v1","max_concurrency":4,"batch_timeout_ms":20}
```

sre-alex: applying priority-based routing: move VIP tenants onto reserved pool that still has capacity, shift low-priority to fallback CPU cluster.

support-sam: messaging drafted to VIPs: "We're experiencing degraded inference performance due to GPU provisioning issues; mitigation in progress; targeted ETA 60-90 minutes." share if ok.

product-lina: send it. include note about temporary rate limits and suggested retries.

infra-maya: rolling update to launch template now: switching ASG to LT version 12 which has `redwood-gpu-role-v2`. Command: 
```
aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-pool-prod-1 --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abc123,Version=12
```

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by infra-maya. CI job #build-789 queued, checks: ok.

sre-alex: while LT update propagates, manually spinning up 2 t4g.2xlarge placeholder instances in a separate transient nodegroup to absorb backlog.

infra-maya: launched 2 instances manually with correct profile as emergency nodes. `ec2 run-instances --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abc123 --version 12 --count 2`

mlops-raj: pods started binding to the manual nodes, a few jobs succeeded — queue backlog dropped ~18% in 8 minutes.

sre-alex: good signal. autoscaler records still show failed launch attempts from 02:12 -> 02:46 UTC, after that repeated success in the ASG activity feed.

support-sam: inbound support tickets trending down, but some customers still see degraded p95. noting affected request ids: [r-7834, r-7891, r-7900].

eng-runtime-joel: runtime metrics show reduced batch sizes and CPU fallback serving ~22% of requests now. error rate for GPU route back to normal-ish.

infra-maya: ASG now referencing LT v12, instances spinning up cleanly. I see nodes join the cluster and taints being applied. need to check taint propagation: some nodes are created with a leftover taint `maintenance=true:NoSchedule` from an old userdata snippet.

sre-alex: removing stale taint from new nodes: `kubectl taint nodes <node-name> maintenance=true:NoSchedule-` — doing this for the two emergency nodes and new ASG nodes.

mlops-raj: after taint removal, pending pods schedule. queue backlog down to ~220. still above usual but much improved.

noncall-nick: handing over to next oncall (sre-alex) for post-mitigation monitoring. leaving notes in the incident runbook channel.

sre-alex: will monitor for 2 hours. next steps: run postmortem checklist, confirm launch template rollback or proper rollout, and validate IAM lifecycle automation to prevent profile deletion mid-rollout.

product-lina: quick customer impact summary for postmortem: "~45 minutes of degraded performance for ~12% of active tenants; VIPs saw transient 5xx; no data loss; mitigations included runtime throttling, manual instance bootstrap, and launch template fix."

support-sam: saving incident notes and customer request ids. Will follow up with customers tomorrow with root-cause summary and ETA for permanent fix.

infra-maya: I've queued an infra-change to add a safety check: deny deletion of instanceprofile while referenced by any launch template/ASG. Also adding an automated alert: `LT->InstanceProfile mismatch` when ASG reports failed instance launches >3 in 5m.

mlops-raj: action item: add a graceful fallback route in the runtime so critical tenants can be cutover automatically if gpu pool falls below threshold.

eng-runtime-joel: will add that to this week's sprint. quick patch exists in staging; will schedule prod rollout after postmortem.

sre-alex: marking incident as mitigated at 3667779400. leaving thread open for additional notes. Postmortem owner: infra-maya.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: mitigated. Duration: 00:42:00. Incident ID: INC-2026-0421-gpu-provision.

infra-maya: preliminary root cause: an automated infra change removed/rotated an instance profile without coordinating ASG/launch-template references. cascade: failed instance profile -> failed instance launches -> autoscaler thrash -> queue growth -> customer impact.

product-lina: thanks everyone. we'll schedule a cross-functional postmortem review Monday.

support-sam: closing out support ticket batch and sending courtesy notes to affected customers.

sre-alex: follow-ups tracked in #incidents-postmortem board.

eng-runtime-joel: final note: keep the temporary runtime throttle config in case of recurrence; will add automatic rollback after 3 hours if cluster recovers.

oncall-nick: thanks team, signing off. :wave:
